main_text.p: si alii non sint, & injuria fit irreparabilis, id certè licebit. Neque hic quicquam differendum: ne post vulneratam causam remedium frustrà quæratur. l. 3. §. cum igitur D. de vi & vi armat. l. 29. §. 7. D. Aquil. l. 1. Cod. quand. lic. unic. fin. jud. l. ult. Cod. de sport. & sumpt. l. 5. Cod. de jure fisc. lib. 10. Castrens. in l. 3. D. de just. & jur. n. 6. Vasq. 1. Illustr. contr. cap. 18. n. 8. Clar. 5. sent. §. Homicidium. n. 30. Boër. decis. 170. n. 1. Covarr. 1. Var. Resol. cap. 2. n. 12. Amef. casub. consc. l. 5. c. 54. in fin.

Quod etiam ad Seniorem, etiam ad summum Principem est extendendum. Neque enim personæ dignitas aut status jus naturale immutat: neque Princeps supra leges est, saltem naturales, fatentibus omnibus. Arg. dd. leg. Berlich. d. Concl. 12. n. 19. 29. 30. Diss. Clar. §. Homicidium.

page.notes: Printed text ends with the catchword-like line "dium." at the right, which is the end of the hyphenated word "Homicidium" and is kept in the paragraph. Print has the missing space in "extendendum.Neque" and in "Diss." / "Clar." and the "dd." citation; these are left as set, with a space added after the full stop for readability. Faint marks at the lower edge and left edge are not printed text and are omitted.
